title: Review Response and Reputation Automation
summary: Collect reviews from Google, OTAs and Tripadvisor, draft specific replies in your voice, route complaints to the GM and turn recurring themes into weekly actions for each department.

seo.title: Hotel Review Response and Reputation AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that drafts specific replies to Google and OTA hotel reviews, routes complaints to managers and reports recurring themes for housekeeping and F&B.

designed_for: Quality and Operations Head for hotel groups

problem.intro: Reviews on Google, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Tripadvisor and Airbnb shape both search visibility and guest choice. Replying well takes time, so many hotels ignore reviews, paste the same thank-you line or answer a complaint days later. The useful signal in reviews, such as repeated comments about AC noise or slow breakfast service, rarely reaches the team that can fix it.

pain_points.title: Replies that sound copied
pain_points.detail: The same thank-you line under every review tells future guests that nobody reads them.

pain_points.title: Complaints answered late or defensively
pain_points.detail: Negative reviews need a measured reply from someone senior, and they wait in a queue or get an emotional response.

pain_points.title: Scattered platforms
pain_points.detail: Google and each OTA have their own extranet or dashboard, so reviews are checked irregularly.

pain_points.title: No loop back to operations
pain_points.detail: Themes about housekeeping, food, staff or maintenance stay on review sites instead of reaching department heads.

solution.overview: We build a review workflow that brings reviews from Google Business Profile and OTAs into one queue, using platform APIs or exports where available. Each review is classified by theme, sentiment, language and urgency, and matched to the stay where possible. An LLM drafts a reply that responds to what the guest actually wrote, in your property's voice and the guest's language. Positive reviews go to a quick approval queue. Negative reviews, and anything about safety, hygiene, discrimination or billing, go to the GM with the draft and the stay details. A weekly report shows recurring themes by department, and opted-in guests are invited to review after checkout without filtering by sentiment.
capabilities: Review collection from Google Business Profile and OTAs via APIs or exports
Theme, sentiment, language and urgency classification
Specific reply drafts in your property's voice and the guest's language
Approval queues: one click for positive reviews, GM review for complaints
Weekly theme reports by department with example quotes
Post-checkout review requests on WhatsApp to every opted-in guest

workflow.title: Collect reviews
workflow.detail: New reviews are pulled from Google and OTA sources into one queue several times a day.

workflow.title: Classify
workflow.detail: Each review is tagged by theme, sentiment, language and urgency, and linked to the stay where possible.

workflow.title: Draft replies
workflow.detail: The LLM drafts a reply that addresses the specific points raised, following your tone and policies.

workflow.title: Route for approval
workflow.detail: Positive replies go to quick approval, and complaints and sensitive topics go to the GM.

workflow.title: Publish
workflow.detail: Approved replies are posted through the platform API or pasted into the extranet by staff.

workflow.title: Report themes
workflow.detail: Weekly summaries show recurring issues by department for managers to act on in their meetings.

inputs: Reviews from Google Business Profile, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Tripadvisor and Airbnb
Stay details from the PMS where available
Brand voice guide and reply policies
outputs: Approved replies, published or ready to paste
Escalations to the GM with stay context
Response time and rating trend tracking
human_in_the_loop: Staff approve every reply before it is published, and the GM handles all negative and sensitive reviews personally. Compensation, refunds or offers are never mentioned in public replies without management approval.
integrations: WhatsApp Business API for post-stay requests
Email or Slack for weekly reports
guardrails: No reply published without human approval
No guest personal details, room numbers or booking data in public replies
Review requests sent to all opted-in guests, never filtered by expected sentiment
No incentives for reviews, and no fake or staff-written reviews
Sensitive topics always escalated to the GM
compliance_notes: Review requests follow platform rules, which generally prohibit selectively soliciting positive reviews or offering incentives for them.
Guest feedback and stay data are processed within purpose and retention limits under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: Google and two OTA review sources for one property, with every draft reviewed by the GM or guest relations team.
deliverables: Brand voice guide and reply policies

what_we_measure.how: Hours from review posting to published reply, before and during the pilot.
Drafts approved as written versus edited, split by sentiment.
Issues from the weekly report that department heads log as actions.
New reviews attributed to post-checkout requests.

faqs.q: Can it reply to reviews without approval?
faqs.a: We recommend approval for every reply and require it for negative reviews. Positive reviews go into a quick queue where staff can approve a batch in a few minutes.

faqs.q: Which platforms can it connect to?
faqs.a: Google Business Profile has an API for reviews and replies. OTA access varies: some offer partner APIs, others need exports or a staff member to paste approved replies into the extranet. We map what is possible for your listings.
Drafts respond to the specific points in each review and follow a voice guide written with you, including how formal to be. Staff edits during the pilot are used to tune the drafts.

faqs.q: Can it reply in Hindi or other languages?
faqs.a: Yes. It drafts replies in the language the guest used, including Hindi and common foreign languages, and staff can view an English translation before approving.
